# appgatesdp_condition (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appgatesdp_condition" "business_hours" {
  name       = "business-hours"
  expression = "return new Date().getHours() >= 8 && new Date().getHours() < 18;"
  tags       = ["terraform"]

  repeat_schedules = ["1h", "13:00"]

  remedy_methods = [{
    type    = "DisplayMessage"
    message = "Access is only allowed during business hours."
  }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expression` (String) Boolean expression in JavaScript.
- `name` (String) Name of the object.

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `remedy_logic` (String) Whether all the Remedy Methods must succeed to pass this Condition or just one.
- `remedy_methods` (Attributes List) The remedy methods that will be triggered if the evaluation fails. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--remedy_methods))
- `repeat_schedules` (List of String) A list of schedules that decides when to reevaluate the Condition. All the scheduled times will be effective. One will not override the other. - It can be a time of the day, e.g. 13:00, 10:25, 2:10 etc. - It can be one of the predefined
  intervals, e.g. 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h. These intervals
  will be always rounded up, i.e. if it's 15m and the
  time is 12:07 when the Condition is evaluated
  first, then the next evaluation will occur at
  12:15, and the next one will be at
  12:30 and so on.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--remedy_methods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `remedy_methods`

Optional:

- `claim_suffix` (String) Suffix to be added to the claim. Required for OtpAuthentication, PasswordAuthentication and Reason remedy methods.
- `message` (String) Message to be shown to the user. Required for all remedy method.
- `provider_id` (String) MFA Provider Id or Identity Provider Id. Required for some remedy method.
- `type` (String) User Action type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Conditions are imported by ID.
terraform import appgatesdp_condition.business_hours 4c07bc67-57ea-42dd-b702-c2d6c45419fc
```
